pricing_offer_versions_approval_chk.name: pricing_offer_versions_approval_chk
pricing_offer_versions_approval_chk.value:
("pricing_offer_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "pricing_offer_versions"."approved_by" is null and "pricing_offer_versions"."approved_at" is null)
        or ("pricing_offer_versions"."status" in ('published', 'retired') and "pricing_offer_versions"."approved_by" is not null
          and "pricing_offer_versions"."approved_at" is not null and "pricing_offer_versions"."approved_by" <> "pricing_offer_versions"."created_by")

message_delivery_attempt_channel_message.name: message_delivery_attempt_channel_message_check
message_delivery_attempt_channel_message.value:
("message_delivery_attempts"."channel" = 'sms' AND "message_delivery_attempts"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "message_delivery_attempts"."email_message_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("message_delivery_attempts"."channel" = 'email' AND "message_delivery_attempts"."email_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "message_delivery_attempts"."message_id" IS NULL)

uniq_data_subject_tenant_email_live.name: uniq_data_subject_tenant_email_live
uniq_data_subject_tenant_email_live.where: erased_at IS NULL AND email_hash IS NOT NULL

sandbox_usage_events_context_chk.name: sandbox_usage_events_context_chk
sandbox_usage_events_context_chk.value:
("sandbox_usage_events"."application_id" IS NULL AND "sandbox_usage_events"."environment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("sandbox_usage_events"."application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sandbox_usage_events"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL)
